mastery_policy.p1_prerequisite_use: P1 prerequisite content may support readiness and recommendations, but is not proof of P3 mastery.
mastery_policy.p3_mastery_evidence: P3 mastery requires P3-aligned canonical question evidence from trainable question and mark-scheme image pairs.
mastery_policy.reporting_boundary: P3 syllabus coverage and P1 prerequisite readiness must be reported separately.

primary.qualification: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics
primary.scope_note: Primary Asterion P3 coverage target. Skills mapped here may support P3 coverage and, when mastery eligible in later phases, P3 mastery evidence.

supporting_prerequisites.qualification: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics
supporting_prerequisites.scope_note: Relevant P1 knowledge may appear as repair, recall, hint, or bridge support for P3 learning. P1-only success must not count as P3 syllabus coverage, P3 Guardian eligibility, P3 region rank, or P3 mastery.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Find binomial terms and coefficients efficiently
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 radians and core trigonometric identities are support-only: they prepare the identity choice, but only reviewed P3 Trigonometry evidence counts as P3 mastery.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: State and use binomial expansion validity
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 radians and quadrant fluency are support-only: they help keep signs, units, and intervals consistent, without counting as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Use discriminant or root conditions as evidence
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebra and functions/graphs support forming and interpreting the discriminant condition. This prerequisite repair is support-only; only reviewed clean P3 route evidence may count for mastery.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Split modulus equations or inequalities into valid cases
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebra and functions/graphs support the distance and interval language used here. These notes are support-only and must not count as P3 mastery, Guardian clearance, export mastery, or candidate-promotion evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Set up partial fractions from denominator structure
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 radians and compound-angle identity fluency are support-only: they prepare the R-form coefficient match, but do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Use polynomial division and remainder or factor theorem evidence
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation supports theorem substitution fluency only. Remainder and factor theorem mastery still requires reviewed P3 evidence with canonical question and mark-scheme assets.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Choose algebraic structure before expanding
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation supports this repair step only. It helps students keep factors, cancellations, and excluded values visible, but it is not P3 mastery evidence or Guardian clearance evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Interpret loci and regions on an Argand diagram
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry and radians/trigonometry are support-only: plotting centres, distances, and angles prepares the locus move but does not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Use Cartesian complex arithmetic and conjugates
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation is support-only here: students should rehearse expanding products and simplifying fractions, but only clean P3 complex-number evidence can count for mastery.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Move between Cartesian and modulus-argument form
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry and radians/trigonometry are support-only: use them to check quadrant and angle work, without treating prerequisite practice as P3 complex-number mastery.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Find complex powers and roots using the suitable form
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation and radians/trigonometry are support-only: exact-angle fluency helps list branches, but only reviewed P3 complex roots/powers evidence can count for mastery.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Form differential equations from rate contexts
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 proportionality language, derivative notation, and basic integration are repair support only: translate the rate statement into a derivative equation before any P3 mastery claim.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Apply initial conditions after integration
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic substitution and basic integration are repair support only: check that a constant of integration exists before substituting a given point.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Separate variables before integrating
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 differentiation notation and basic integration rules are repair support only: rehearse rearranging dy/dx equations and integrating simple powers before counting any P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Apply chain, product, and quotient rules accurately
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 differentiation basics, algebraic simplification, and function notation support rule setup only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Differentiate implicit log or exponential relations
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation, differentiation basics, and function notation support implicit derivative collection only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Name the differentiation method before differentiating
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 differentiation basics and function-structure recognition support choosing the derivative route only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Differentiate parametric equations using the derivative ratio
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry and differentiation basics support parameter differentiation and line-gradient follow-through only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Use derivatives for stationary points, tangents, and normals
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry and basic differentiation support tangent, normal, and stationary-point follow-through only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Evaluate definite and improper integrals exactly
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 functions/graphs and basic integration are support-only: they help evaluate bounds and signs, but do not count as P3 integration mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Choose a direct rule, substitution, parts, or algebraic rewrite
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation and basic integration rules are support-only: they help recognise structure and transform simple integrals, but do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Integrate rational functions using partial fractions
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation, factorisation, simple simultaneous equations, coefficient comparison, excluded denominator values, and basic rational-term integration are support-only prerequisites: they prepare the partial-fraction setup and logarithmic follow-through, but they do not count as P3 integration mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Use integration by parts or substitution with correct setup
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation and basic integration rules are support-only: they prepare substitution and parts setup, but only reviewed P3 evidence counts for mastery.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Handle log and exponential functions inside calculus questions
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 differentiation basics and function notation support the log or exponential calculus setup only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Convert between logarithmic and exponential form
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation and function notation support the conversion step only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Reject invalid logarithmic roots using domain checks
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation and function-domain awareness support the original-argument checks only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Solve exponential equations using matching bases or natural logs
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation, inverse-function awareness, and index laws support exponential-equation rearrangement only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Use log laws to solve logarithmic equations
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation, function notation, and index-law fluency support log-law equation rearrangement only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Linearise logarithmic or exponential relationships
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic manipulation, function notation, and straight-line graph interpretation support the linearisation setup only; these prerequisites do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Control accuracy and rounding in numerical solutions
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 calculator accuracy and rounding conventions support this skill; they are prerequisite repair only and must not promote P3 numerical-method mastery.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Apply an iteration formula consistently
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 algebraic rearrangement and function notation support reading the recurrence, but P3 mastery must come from clean iteration evidence with canonical question and mark-scheme images.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Justify roots using sign changes or graph evidence
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 function-evaluation and graph-intersection ideas support the sign-change explanation only; they must not be counted as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Solve trig equations over a specified interval
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 radians, interval notation, and core trig identities are support-only: they help preserve branches and units, but do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Choose trig identities for proof or simplification
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 radians and core trigonometric identities are support-only: they prepare the identity choice, but only reviewed P3 Trigonometry evidence counts as P3 mastery.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Use quadrant discipline to find every trig solution
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 radians and quadrant fluency are support-only: they help keep signs, units, and intervals consistent, without counting as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Rewrite a sin and cos combination in R-form
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 radians and compound-angle identity fluency are support-only: they prepare the R-form coefficient match, but do not count as P3 mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Transform reciprocal and double-angle equations safely
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 reciprocal, double-angle, and radian fluency are support-only: they prepare safe transformations, but only reviewed P3 evidence can count for mastery.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Translate 3D geometric conditions into vector equations
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry supports point and component handling only; modelling 3D vector conditions remains P3-only mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Form and compare vector equations of lines
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry supports component comparison and simultaneous-equation fluency only; it must not count as P3 vector-line mastery evidence.

per_skill_inventory.micro_skill_name: Use scalar products for angles and perpendicular conditions
per_skill_inventory.prerequisite_notes: P1 coordinate geometry supports coordinate fluency and angle awareness only; P3 mastery still requires scalar-product evidence from reviewed P3 vector questions.

resolved_mismatches.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic is logarithms_and_exponentials; DeepSeek gives an unmapped Calculus label; the question has differentiation and integration subparts.

resolved_mismatches.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic is parametric_equations; DeepSeek/app routing emphasize integration by parts; the question has a maximum-point subpart.
